_comment: Presentation of the FTB quest book, compiled by tools/generate_quests.py and tools/quest_engine.py. Scale, grammar, rewards, colours and the hub: docs/design/quest-book.md (v2) and docs/design/quest-book-v3.md (sector chapters, reward tables, motifs, presets).

es_es: Seis actos bajo un mismo sol.

sector_rewards._comment: Reward cadence of sector chapters by role (docs/design/quest-book-v3.md). xp multiplies the guide XP of the act.

reward_tables._comment: Reward tables and loot crates by act (docs/design/quest-book-v3.md): moderate, never ENTRELUMEN components or outputs of gated recipes. Rows: [item, count, weight].

immersive._comment: Blueprint blue and hazard yellow: Immersive Engineering's workshop and industry sheets. Milestones are rounded squares, like machine blocks.

create._comment: Copper and brass: the gear chapter and the railway chapter.

ars._comment: Violet and source-gem purple: the ritual circle.

twilight._comment: Dusk over moss, with firefly light: the Twilight Oak (roots, trunk, crown and beanstalk).

ae2._comment: Certus blue traces, fluix violet panels and the pink glow of a lit cable: the network board and the pattern provider.

storage._comment: Leather and buckskin: the backpack chapter.

farm._comment: Straw gold and field green: the kitchen table and the field in rows. Milestones are hearts, after Spice of Life.

mekanism._comment: Steel and osmium cyan: the control-circuit chip, the turbine and the teleporter.

irons._comment: Mana blue and ink indigo: the ring of schools around the Inscription Table and the Upgrade Orb's rune board. Milestones are pentagons, a spell sigil's shape.

rs._comment: Steel casing and the cyan glow of a powered cutout: Refined Storage's disk drive with its eight slots. Lines run steel gray and light up cyan once done, like a device coming online.

aether._comment: Sky blue and ambrosium gold: the ascent from the glowstone portal through floating islands to the sun, and the Eye of the Storm. Milestones are pentagons, like cut gems.

pnc._comment: Brass, compressed iron and the pressure gauge's green, amber and red: the gauge dial and the drone program. Milestones are round, like gauges and rotors.

occultism._comment: Chalk on otherstone, spiritfire lavender and ritual violet: the chalk pentacle and the storage stabilizers' target. Milestones are pentagons.

bumblezone._comment: Honey amber, beeswax and brood brown: the comb of the hive in the first chapter, six colored sanctum cells around the essences in the second. Milestones keep the hexagon: every node is a cell.

oritech._comment: Oritech's panel orange, the accelerator's steel tube and particle cyan: the particle accelerator ring, eight straight guides meeting at 45 degrees. Milestones are octagons, like the ring.

powah._comment: Dielectric slate and the teal glow of Powah's cables and Ender Cells: the Energizing Orb with its rods and the tier bar rising in Powah's own tier colours. Lines run slate and light up teal once done, like a charged cable.

ma._comment: Inferium lime on field green: five furrows tinted by essence tier, and the awakening altar ringed by pedestals and vessels. Milestones are round, like essence orbs.

if._comment: Machine-frame graphite, casing white and the cyan of IF's machine screens: a laser beam down the four frame tiers into the Ore Laser Base, with the sixteen lenses around it. Milestones are squares, like machine blocks.

mi._comment: Bronze under steam, machine steel and the orange of a hot ingot: the boiler, the transformer, the circuit board and the reactor. Milestones stay hexagons, like bolt heads.

bees._comment: Bee yellow on hive-dark brown, with wax-cream lines: the apiary is a centrifuge seen from above whose spiral fills with honey, the breeding tree keeps wild bees in its roots and a family on each branch, metal bees fill the cells of a comb, and mod bees bloom as flowers under a crown. Milestones keep the hexagon, a comb cell.

jdt._comment: Time-crystal green over Shadowpulse slate, lines in Primogel lavender: four goo columns rising from Primogel to Shadowpulse, and the Paradox Machine at the centre of its own growing rings. Milestones stay hexagons.

draconic._comment: Draconium violet and the orange of awakened draconium, with chaos red: the Energy Core with its stabilizers and pylons, and the Draconic Reactor between its stabilizers. Milestones are round, like cores and spheres.

cataclysm._comment: Void lilac and the red-orange of Ignis's flame: the compass of arena eyes and the armory wheel around the fusion anvil, each boss under the frame of its own health bar.

apotheosis._comment: Dusk over obsidian, the mauve ring of the World Tier screen and the orange of Mythic loot: the enchanting table ringed by its shelves under Eterna, Quanta and Arcana, the tier mountain from Haven to Pinnacle, and a monster spawner's cage. Milestones keep the hexagon, a cut gem's face.

malum._comment: Runewood amber lines, soulwood plum panels and the Arcane spirit's magenta: the Spirit Altar's pedestal ring with a wheel of the eight arcana at its heart, each ray ending in its rune. Milestones keep the hexagon.

undergarden._comment: Depthrock moss and the jade of Forgotten metal, with Utherium red for the Depths: a cross-section from the six-brick portal on the grass, down a mineshaft through the cavern and the Forgotten halls, past the Dreadrock into the Depths above the lava. Milestones stay hexagons.

forbidden._comment: Deorum gold lines over darkstone violet, accent in arcane crystal periwinkle: the Hephaestus Forge seen from above, its 9x9 floor, eight pedestals and the mod's own ritual circles, with the Clibano's 3x3 face in a corner. Milestones are rounded squares, like pedestal tops.

theurgy._comment: Sulfur yellow, quicksilver lines and the smoky violet of the Hermetica's cover: the squared circle of the Great Work, the tria prima triangle inside it and the athanor around the incubator, with the twelve niters on the rim. Milestones keep the hexagon, the seal of fire and water.

starlight._comment: Night indigo, lunar violet and the Glimmering Tablet's pale cyan: the diamond portal opening onto a sky of biome constellations, a meteor shower of metals and arms, and the Orb of Prophecy between the Golem Forge and the Cursed Garden. Milestones are round, like the Orb and the dead star.

integrated._comment: Logic Cable cyan over menril blue: the backbone from the grove to the Logic Programmer forks into logic and tunnels and meets again at a Display Panel's bezel; lines light up with the cable's pale core once done.

rftools._comment: Machine-frame gunmetal with the pale rim of an RFTools casing, dimensional-shard cyan as the accent, and XNet's cable colours on the lanes: the machine frame at the centre with a port for each module, the RFTools branches around it and XNet's four channel lanes running east to the routers. Milestones are rounded squares, like machine faces.

naturesaura._comment: Gold leaf over the Overworld's aura green (the mod's own 0x89CC37), on moss: the Natural Altar in the middle of the Ritual of the Forest, sixteen gold powder cells and eight wooden stands, with the aura spreading outward in rings. Completed lines turn gold, like leaves under Brilliant Fiber. Milestones stay hexagons.

enderio._comment: Void-chassis grey, dark-steel slate and the chrome of a polished machine face: a four-core conduit bundle (item, fluid, energy, redstone) runs from the grains to the octadic capacitor, two-core branches feed a panel per machine family, and each core fills with its colour once that conduit is made; the grinding balls ring the SAG mill. Milestones are rounded squares, like machine blocks.

aa._comment: Black quartz slate, the Atomic Reconstructor's blue beam and Restonia red: the beam runs through its lenses to the Empowerer's altar of four display stands, and the six crystals crown the capstone. Milestones are rounded squares, like machine casings.

logistics._comment: LaserIO's default red beam over deep steel, with pipe-steel lines: the network map in an S, Pipez pipes as coloured rails on top, laser beams between the LaserIO nodes in the middle and flux rings around the controller at the bottom.

routers._comment: The gold of a blank module's corners on the router's stone grey, lines in GUI beige: the Modular Router's own screen, buffer, five upgrade slots and nine module slots, beside a module's screen with its filter grid and augment slots. Milestones are rounded squares, like the slots.

reliquary._comment: Quartz and Midas gold on void-tear purple: Reliquary's own pedestal seen from the front (base, switch band, shaft, capital with its gold lip, wool cushion) carries the relic trunk up its shaft, and the Phoenix Down floats over the cushion in a ring of relics. The handgun, the apothecary and the other relics sit in purple velvet display cases on both sides, the hunt below the base. The switch lights up with the first working pedestal. Milestones stay hexagons.

psi._comment: The Spell Programmer's charcoal 9x9 grid with the trident of Psi's logo traced through it, psidust violet with the cyan of a compiled spell: the trunk is the trident, spell pieces and bullets fill the quadrants, Ebony & Ivory and the Exosuit sit between its prongs, and the CAD Assembler's bench waits under the grid. Milestones are rounded squares, like spell pieces.

artifacts._comment: Mimic-chest red wood, trinket gold and tooth cream, read from artifacts:textures/entity/mimic.png and the trinket icons: a Curios paper doll whose head, neck, belt, right hand and feet carry the five slot milestones and whose chest carries the full kit; where to look on the left, kits on the right, one-of-a-kind pieces below. Milestones are rounded squares, like the slots they stand for.

hnn._comment: Simulation-chamber black and terminal cyan, read from hostilenetworks:textures/block/simulation_chamber_north.png and the Deep Learner HUD, with the mod's five tier colours: a neural network whose input layer is the Deep Learner, whose hidden layer is the tier ladder and whose output is the Data Center, fully connected by faint synapses; the training set of models worth simulating runs along a data bus below. Milestones are circles, like neurons.

evilcraft._comment: Arterial red lines and dried-blood panels on dark-gem slate: a blood drop whose outline carries the trunk, the blood line down its right side and round belly, the spirit line down its left, the Box of Eternal Closure in its heart and a vengeance vortex around it; the drop fills with blood as the milestones land. Milestones are hearts.

silentgear._comment: Blueprint blue, chalk white and tyrian magenta: the chapter is a blueprint of a pickaxe on a gridded sheet, and finished lines turn to chalk. The trunk climbs the handle from the Stone Anvil to the Alloy Forge at the collar, then traces the head's outline, crimson and grading on the left arm, azure and tyrian on the right, meeting at the apex in the masterwork, which inks the head in tyrian. Panels sit around the drawing like callouts. Milestones keep the hexagon.

mahou._comment: Dried-blood lines on a deep blood panel, after the red (0x810A0A) of the mod's own circle, mahoutsukai 1.36.27 assets/mahoutsukai/textures/block/mahoujin.png, lifted for text. The chapter is that mahoujin: a double ring with four seals, a twelve-point star of four triangles, a square and three catalyst circles. The trunk walks the twelve points and ends in the inner circles; the schools radiate out as rays. Milestones are circles.

adastra._comment: Ad Astra's planet screen over deep space: pale steel-blue lines, navy panels, and the gold of the mod's own sun (adastra 1.16.19 assets/ad_astra/textures/environment/sun.png, 0xFFD54A) for accents and flown routes. The chapter is that screen: the Sun with its orbits, the mod's square pixel planets as the landing nodes, a launch site on Earth's grass at the bottom and Proxima Centauri off in a corner. Milestones are circles, like planets.

deep._comment: Sculk cyan over Deep Dark navy, after the glow of deeperdarker 1.4.1 textures/item/heart_of_the_deep.png. The chapter is a cross-section: grass, stone with a geode and a fossil, a switchback tunnel down to the ancient city, whose 9x7 frame of reinforced deepslate (minecraft 1.21.1 textures/block/reinforced_deepslate_side.png and _top.png) lights up when the Otherside opens; the Warden gear is forged under a ruined portico, the Warden waits over its shriekers. Below the bedrock, the 6x3 frame the mod builds on the far side, four caverns tinted with the biomes' own fog colours (deeperdarker worldgen/biome/*.json) that fill with trees, pillars and flowers as they are visited, and the ancient temple, whose secret room wires the transmitter back to a barrel at home. JAMD's three flat worlds (jamd 21.1.1 dimension/*.json layers) float in the sky. Milestones keep the hexagon.

computercraft._comment: CraftOS yellow (colors.yellow, 0xDEDE6C) and the Advanced Computer's bezel (#C7C86E, cc-tweaked 1.120.2 assets/computercraft/textures/gui/border_advanced.png) on terminal black. The chapter is the computer itself: its screen shows a Lua prompt with the software tips as output, and cables run to its four sides, paper and sound on the left, the control room's monitor wall on the right, the wire and a sky of rednet waves above, turtles digging below ground. Milestones are rounded squares, like the computer's case.

aircraft._comment: Boiler copper (#E87C54, immersive_aircraft 1.5.2 assets/immersive_aircraft/textures/item/boiler.png, lifted for text), sail canvas and hull wood on a dusk sky. The chapter is a biplane seen from above: the trunk climbs the fuselage from the tail to the engine at the wing root, airships fill the left wing and fixed wings the right, upgrades sit by the nose, and the fleet appears in the sky as each aircraft is built. Milestones are circles, like gauges.

gadgets._comment: Workshop shadow board: warm hardboard panels, chalk lines and safety-yellow accents, like the painted outlines of a tool wall. The trunk runs along the workbench edge; every helper hangs in its own painted outline on the pegboard, its real texture appears over the shadow when its key quest is done, and small chalk drawings (rainbow, laser, field lines, shaft) light up with their quests. Milestones keep the hexagon.

creatures._comment: A naturalist's field map, after the vanilla map parchment (minecraft 1.21.1 assets/minecraft/textures/map/map_background.png, #D6BE96 paper and #99876C edge): the chapter is that page, faint, with a cross-section of the world inked in cream: sea and coast, woods, home, jungle and swamp, savanna and desert and the snowy peaks, the caves and the Wrought Chamber below, a bedrock floor, the Nether under it and the End floating top right. Creatures are pins where they live; the trunk is the field guide in the sky, five pages under the sun, and each sun ray lights up when its page is done. Moss panels, leaf-green accent; milestones are rounded squares, like pages.

role_colors._comment: Node outline colours of sector roles (ARGB). Completed and started keep FTB colours except secrets.

entrelumen.quests.toast.secret.en_us: The Atlas never mentioned this one.
entrelumen.quests.toast.secret.es_es: El Atlas no dijo nada de esto.
